meta.name: Night Shift
meta.author: ZenNovel
meta.description: One minute of night on a dangerous street. Your mouse is the torch: search the dark, follow people across, react when the torch fails, and choose who to light first.

variables.name: The old lady’s crossing is over

commands.text: You're the new one? Tonight the night shift on this street is yours.
After dark, half the lamps are out and the cars drive faster than in daylight. You've got one job: everyone gets through safe.

options.text: The big torch: a wide beam, but it eats batteries.
The old torch: a narrow beam, but it lasts.

commands.text: Your mouse is the torch. Drivers only see what your light is on, and nobody can hide in it. When you see someone, hold the light steady on them.

commands.prompt: Over by the shops, someone seems to be picking a bike lock…
The lamp's gone. Someone seems to be standing under it.
A car! Keep the light on her so the driver sees her!

options.text: Light the boy chasing the ball
Light the woman on her phone

commands.prompt: Two people in the road at once! Who first?

options.text: Light the boy chasing the ball
Light the woman on her phone

commands.text: Morning. The street lamps go out one by one.

then.text: That old lady last night broke her arm. She's in hospital. The driver says he never saw anyone in the road.

else.text: Young one, that was you last night, wasn't it? When that light came on me, I knew somebody was watching out for me. Steamed buns, still hot.

then.text: Old Li at the repair shop had his bike stolen. He's been cursing on his doorstep all morning.
Not one thing went wrong. All right. This street's nights are yours.

else.text: This street's nights are longer than you think. Come back tomorrow.

then.text: [Tonight you kept all 5 things safe. Take the other torch and guard another night?]
[Tonight you kept 4 of 5 things safe. Take the other torch and guard another night?]
[Tonight you kept 3 of 5 things safe. Take the other torch and guard another night?]
[Tonight you kept 2 of 5 things safe. Take the other torch and guard another night?]
[Tonight you kept 1 of 5 things safe. Keep the light on people. Another night?]
[Tonight nothing was kept safe. Keep the light on people. Another night?]
